package_info.why_malicious: These packages are part of a dependency confusion attack targeting John Deere's private npm dependencies. They are designed to be installed in place of legitimate internal packages, potentially allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code or exfiltrate data if included in a build pipeline.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During installation, the code executes a shell command that collects environment variables and sends them via HTTP POST to an external attacker-controlled domain, enabling environment data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Postinstall scripts that exfiltrate environment variables to external domains are a hallmark of supply chain attacks.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not send environment data to external servers during installation.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate packages may use postinstall scripts for telemetry or analytics, but never to exfiltrate sensitive environment data.

attack_chain.action: Malicious package is published to npm with a name matching a private John Deere dependency.
attack_chain.leads_to: Accidental installation in internal build pipelines due to dependency confusion.

attack_chain.action: Postinstall script executes upon package installation, collecting environment variables.
attack_chain.leads_to: Exfiltration of sensitive environment data to attacker.

behavioral_signatures: Presence of postinstall scripts making network requests
Collection and exfiltration of environment variables during install
file_indicators: References to external domains in install scripts
network_indicators: HTTP/HTTPS POST requests to unknown or attacker-controlled domains during install
Unusual outbound traffic from build environments at install time
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for npm packages with postinstall scripts that make network requests, especially those referencing external domains. Flag packages with names similar to known internal dependencies. Inspect build logs for unexpected outbound connections during dependency installation.
